d: Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) partners with mid-market and fast growth businesses across the world, especially with clients with international presence and aspirations. CCB Middle East & Africa cluster covers the U.A.E., Turkey, Israel, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and Egypt. It is one of the largest business clusters for CCB in EMEA, and a strategic growth market for CCB globally. Cash management solutions are a core part of the business’ strategy and are expected to continue driving the cluster’s expansion. The CCB The Middle East & Africa Cash Management Sales Officer will be focused on working closely with Commercial Banking Relationship Managers (RM) to grow Cash revenues, leveraging Citi’s global network. With complex Cash solution capabilities and solution centric sales, CCB Middle East & Africa will continue to attract a sizeable number of new client relationships to the franchise, while managing its existing portfolio.

The key outline of this role is to help nurture the growth of Transaction banking & Trade revenues for Internationally parented CCB clients with subsidiaries in the MEA Region. An ongoing commitment to identify new revenue streams and flows, support and own RFPs and deepen wallet penetration for revenue realisation. This is an experienced individual contributor role that is expected to deliver fast sustainable growth with the ability to manage multiple clients and senior management demands along with an eye to engage & turbo charge the network.
q: Interpersonal and communication skills for effective presentations, pitches and conversions.
Ability to quickly identify problems and solutions leveraging Transaction banking & Trade product propositions, business drivers, policies, customer needs and market trends
Ability to create long term, positive trust and advisory based relationships will all the customers in the portfolio.
Demonstrate thought leadership and vision for future planning and growth.
Open-mindedness to evaluate various alternative solutions to customer needs.
Knowledge of and keen interest to learn further about regulations, market practices and bank operations.

Overseeing project cost accounting, capitalization, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
Supporting development feasibility, investment evaluation, and financial performance management.
Managing financial governance, audits, and compliance requirements within complex project environments.

r: Lead development accounting activities across assigned development projects, portfolios, and capital investment programs.

Lead and develop development accounting teams while promoting continuous improvement, automation, and financial best practices.
